name: Fort-Dauphin Tourisme — ORTA Anôsy (site officiel)
used_for: Regional tourism office; destination list; useful links
notes: Official website of the Office Régional du Tourisme d'Anôsy. Published address 3 Rue Abel Realy, Tôlagnaro, phone +261 34 29 373 83.

name: Annuaire des membres de l'ORTA Anôsy
used_for: 56 member listings with category and phone
notes: Single most valuable source for the dataset. Categories: Hébergements, Hôtel Restaurant, Restaurants, Tour Opérateur, Agences de Voyage, Guide, Artisants. Membership proves directory registration, NOT current trading.

name: ORTA member directory (WordPress REST endpoint)
used_for: Structured member records with category taxonomy
notes: Business Directory Plugin REST endpoint exposed by the public site. Used to enumerate all 56 members and their category IDs.

name: ORTA individual member pages
notes: All 56 member pages fetched. Every page carries a phone; the free-text Description field is unpopulated on most and contains the literal string 'description'.

name: ORTA — Les sites touristiques de l'Anôsy
used_for: Official list of the region's nine nature and heritage sites
notes: Names: Tsitongambarika, Parc Andohahela, Réserve de Berenty, Domaine de la Cascade, Jardin botanique de Saïadi, Réserve de Nahampoana, Grotte d'Agnalapatsy, Lac Anony, Lac Lagnorano.

name: ORTA — Les plages de l'Anôsy
notes: Ankoba, Libanona, Ambinanibe, Amparihy, Baie de Monseigneur, Lokaro. States the destination has close to 200 km of coastline.

name: ORTA — Le surf à Fort-Dauphin
used_for: Surf season, water temperature, swell direction, four named spots
notes: Best primary source for surf: season mainly June–September, water 23–27 °C, swell from the south and south-east, north-east trade winds. Spots: Plage d'Ankoba, Baie de Monseigneur, Plage d'Ambinanibe, Port Ehoala.

name: Linkees — Tolagnaro place directory (index page)
used_for: Index of 228 places by category; 109 individual slugs
notes: Index page renders server-side and was readable. It reports 28 hotels, 25 restaurants, 13 shops, 9 bars. Individual place pages are NOT accessible (see linkees-places).

name: Linkees — individual place pages
notes: Each place page returns a JavaScript browser-verification interstitial ('Verifying your browser...', ~4 KB, 29 characters of text). Not bypassed, per the instruction not to circumvent technical protections. Only the index page was used.

name: Tourismer Madagascar — Taolagnaro et ses environs
used_for: Long-form descriptions of sites, reserves and practicalities
notes: Source of the 7.5 km distance to Nahampoana, the 8 km to Domaine de la Cascade, the ownership of Nahampoana by Air Fort Services, the Sainte-Luce reserve description and the Evatraha bungalows.

name: CARA Anôsy — Le tourisme à Fort-Dauphin
used_for: Regional biodiversity, heritage and watersports overview
notes: Source of the whale-watching windows (June–July and September–November), the 529 m height of Pic Saint-Louis, the named beaches and surf/kite/windsurf spots, and the baie des Galions. Names no establishments; its Annuaire/membres page returns 404.

name: Mada Voyage — Fort-Dauphin (Tôlagnaro)
notes: Source of the two-hour climb of Pic Saint-Louis, the Lokaro pirogue itinerary via Lac Lanirano and Évatraha, the central market description, the currents warning and the flight-versus-road comparison.

name: Le Petit Voyageur Madagascar — annuaire Fort-Dauphin
used_for: Recommended hotels, restaurants and sites with phone numbers
notes: Next.js page that renders only the 'recommended' blocks. Provided Kaleta Hôtel, Chez Anita, Le Dauphin, L'Arrivage, La Reine du Sud, Rex Restaurant Pizzeria, Nahampoana, Libanona and Fort Flacourt. Several phone numbers on this page are reused across different establishments — flagged in the records.

name: Wikipédia (fr) — Tôlanaro
used_for: Sites remarquables and surf sections; heritage narrative
notes: Used for the 529 m altitude, the Nahampoana botanical history, the Berenty fauna census (3 diurnal lemurs, 99 bird species), the Tranovato and Fort Flacourt history, and the surf spots and season.

name: Wikipédia (fr) — Parc national d'Andohahela
notes: Provides the park's published coordinates (24°44′29″S 46°44′02″E). Article is a stub; practical information is absent.

name: Wikipédia (fr) — Réserve de Berenty
used_for: Reserve size, creation date, lemur species
notes: Source of the 200 ha figure, the 1936 creation date, the 1 000 ha ensemble with Bealoka and Rapily, the Henry de Heaulme sisal plantation, and the coordinates 25°00′33″S 46°18′08″E.

name: Wikipedia (en) — Andohahela National Park
notes: Consulted to cross-check the French article. English-language corroboration for the park's location and parcels.

name: Musée de Fort-Flacourt (site officiel)
notes: Source of the opening hours (Mon–Sat 08:00–11:00 and 14:00–17:00, Sun 14:00–17:00, last entry 30 min before closing, closed on public holidays), phone +261 34 23 372 12 and museeflacourt@gmail.com.

name: Réserve de Nahampoana (site officiel)
notes: Source of the reserve's official phone (+261) 34 46 122 80, which differs from the number published by the Petit Voyageur directory.

name: Domaine de la Cascade (site officiel)
notes: Source of the 136 ha area, the 17 km of trails, the four guided circuits (30 min to 4 h), the two bungalows, camping and the Ecocert plantations. The phone number on the site is ambiguously encoded and was therefore not published.

name: Réserve de Berenty (site officiel) + WordPress REST API
used_for: Room categories, address, phone, email, driving time
notes: The site's REST API (/index.php?rest_route=/wp/v2/pages) was readable and richer than the rendered pages. Source of the 24 rooms, three room categories, the Amboasary address and the '4 to 5 hours / about 85 km' driving time. Also contains an unfilled template address contact@mysite.com, ignored.

name: Mandrare River Camp / Madagascar Classic Collection (site officiel)
used_for: Camp location, access by charter, contact details
notes: Source of the camp's siting near Ifotaka, the twice-weekly charters to Ifotaka airstrip five minutes away, the 3.5-hour private road transfer alternative, and the operator's contact details.

name: Madagascar Classic Collection (site officiel)
used_for: Manafiafy Forest Lodge details and closure dates
notes: Serves the same content as madrare.com. Source of the five thatched bungalows, the annual closure from 10 January to 25 March, and the 'approximately one hour from Fort Dauphin' location note.

name: Kaleta Hotel (site officiel)
notes: Source of the 3-star rating, the 'about ten kilometres from the airport, facing the sea' description, the service list, phone +261 20 92 212 87 and two email addresses. Room prices render as 'Ariary / Nuit' with the amount loaded dynamically.

name: Talinjoo Boutique Hôtel (site officiel)
notes: Source of the four room categories, the sea-front location on Libanona bay, phone +261 34 05 212 35 and contact@talinjoo.com. Its restaurant/bar page confirms the restaurant is open to non-residents.

name: Air Fort Services (site officiel)
used_for: Agency scope, founding year, phone, email
notes: Source of phone +261 20 92 212 24 and contact@airfortservices.com, the claim of being established since 1990, the car-rental activity and the management of Nahampoana park. Much of the descriptive text is promotional content published by the agency itself.

name: Dadamanga (site officiel)
notes: Confirms a dedicated 'Fort Dauphin & South East' page. The testimonials on the site are promotional content published by the operator, not independent reviews.

name: Région Anosy — liste des entreprises
notes: Consulted as a cross-check on registered businesses. Has no restaurant or tourism-provider category, so it added no records.

name: OpenStreetMap — object pages and APIs
used_for: Coordinates, names, tags, addresses, opening hours
notes: Coordinates for 111 named features were retrieved through the Overpass API and Nominatim and re-checked against the OSM API. ODbL-licensed. Used only as a geographic and tagging source: an OSM object is NOT evidence that a business is trading.

name: Overpass API (public mirrors)
notes: The only service used for bulk POI extraction. Heavily rate-limited and frequently saturated during this pass (429 and 502 responses, and periods of no connectivity); several category queries had to be retried or were abandoned. Queries were narrow, spaced, and given a descriptive User-Agent.

name: Nominatim geocoding API
notes: Used with a descriptive User-Agent and rate-limited to roughly one request per second, to resolve named places that the Overpass queries did not return. Every coordinate obtained this way is recorded with its source.

name: Wikimedia Commons (API and file pages)
notes: Source of every image recorded in image-attribution.csv. Licence, author and credit line were read from each file's metadata via the imageinfo API.

name: Petit Futé — Fort-Dauphin
notes: Named as a priority source in the brief, but the site returns HTTP 403 to this client for both the search and the destination pages. Not bypassed.

name: Tripadvisor — Fort-Dauphin
notes: Returns HTTP 403 to this client. Not bypassed.

name: Booking.com — Fort-Dauphin
notes: Returns HTTP 202 with an anti-bot challenge and an empty body. Not bypassed, which is why no accommodation price could be recorded.

name: Facebook — public business pages
notes: Direct requests return HTTP 400. Facebook page URLs recorded in the dataset mean 'this link appeared on an authoritative page we fetched', not 'the page content was read'. Two page titles (Mandrare River Camp, Berenty) were readable through the fetch tool.

name: manafiafy.com — EXCLUDED, domain repurposed
notes: The domain that once served Manafiafy Forest Lodge now serves an unrelated Vietnamese gambling site. It must not be used or cited as the lodge's website; the real content is at madaclassic.com.

name: Madagascar National Parks
notes: Neither parcs-madagascar.com nor madagascar-national-parks.com resolved from this environment. As a result no entry fee, contact or opening hours could be recorded for Andohahela National Park.

name: SEED Madagascar
notes: Not reachable from this environment, so the Sainte-Luce reserve and the ACP camp could not be confirmed as open to visitors with the NGO itself.

name: Le Petit Voyageur Madagascar (site)
notes: Reachable and partly server-rendered. Only the recommendation blocks were readable for Fort-Dauphin.

name: Built-in web search tool — UNAVAILABLE
notes: The agent's search tool failed with HTTP 402 (insufficient balance) for the whole session. All research was therefore done by direct fetch of specific URLs plus the OpenStreetMap APIs. This is the single biggest methodological limitation of this pass.
